gap.title: Every linear space of 5 x 5 complex matrices on which the sums of subpermanents of every size vanish has dimension at most 8; it may be false
gap.statement: ∀ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 5 × Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∑ f : Fin 5 ↪ Fin 5, ∏ i, (1 + t (i, f i))) = 120) → Module.finrank ℂ L ≤ 8
gap.unlocks: the ceiling at five rows and five columns in the table of small cases
gap.context: Needed by seat-barrier-1 for the table of small cases of the dimension bound for such spaces. The statement needs only the pinned library. The largest dimension known is 7. A refutation is an explicit such space of dimension 9; either answer is wanted.
